newsitem.title: CHINA: Yuan closes slightly up at intra-day high.
newsitem.headline: Yuan closes slightly up at intra-day high.

text.p: The Chinese yuan ended up at an intra-day high of 8.3009 against the U.S. dollar on Wednesday from Tuesday's 8.3012 in slow trading, traders said.
The yuan opened slightly up at 8.3010 and consolidated between 8.3012 and 8.3016 for most of the session, hitting an intra-day low of 8.3019, before rising to close at a high.
Trading was dull, with most done at 8.3015, and the yuan was stable in the absence of market-moving news, dealer said.
"The yuan has consolidated around 8.3010 for three days and the situation will change little before the end of the year," one dealer said.
"Demand for the yuan is expected to increase gradually with the approach of the year-end, which will support the yuan at 8.3020," a second dealer said.
"But the rise may be capped by the central bank which wants to keep the yuan stable around the key 8.3000 level," he added.
Dealer expect the yuan to move around the 8.3010 level on Thursday.
The yuan ended down at an intra-day low of 7.3500 from 7.2700 against 100 Japanese yen and down at the intra-day low of 1.0742 from 1.0725 against the Hong Kong dollar.
